text.en:
The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" as classified
under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall
be accorded a minimum
50% MOP as specified in Column 13 thereof. In
effect, such articles
shall be subject to the BBC Preferential
accordance with the schedule indicated opposite each article as specified in
Columns 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19 and 20 of Annex "A".

The MOP provided in Annex "A" on radiator and panel, dash
lower for Corolla (Models EE 100, EE 101, AE 101) passenger cars under the
Toyota Motor Corporation
BBC Scheme shall be accorded exclusively to the
BBC entity in Malaysia (UMW Toyota
Motor Sdn. Bhd.) and in Thailand
(Toyota Motor Thailand Co. Ltd.), respectively, effective from 15 October 1992
up to 14 October 1996. Thereafter, the same MOP may be granted to a
non-participating
ASEAN country as soon as that country extends the same
MOP itself. If the non-participating
country does not wish to grant such MOP
and maintains
throughout the stipulated maximum waiver
period of eight (8) years, the exclusive application of the MC? to Malaysia and
shall then be extended up to 13 October 2000.

The MOP provided in Annex "A" on link assembly, steering gear
for TUV (Models KF40, KF50, CF50) motor vehicles for the transport
passengers and goods under the Toyota Motor Corporation BBC Scheme shall
be accorded exclusively to the BBC entity in Malaysia (UMW Toyota Motor
Sdn. Bhd.) effective 04 October 1993 up to 03 October 1997. T~lereafter, the
same MOP may be gr~nted to a non-participating ASEAN country as soon as
that country extends the same MOP itself. If the non-participating
does not wish to grant such MOP and maintains such position throughout
the stipulated
waiver period of eight (8) years, the exclusive
application of the MOP to Malaysia shall then be extended up to 02 October
2001.

The MOP provided
in Annex "A" on transmission
Liteace (Models KM 36, CM36) comr::lercial vehicles and TUV (Models KF40,
motor vehicles for the
of passengers and goods and
on trim parts for Corolla
(Models EE 100, EE 101, AE 101) passenger cars
Corporation

exclusively to the BBC entity in Malaysia
(UMW Toyota Motor Sdn. Bhd.)
effective 1 January
1995 up to 30 December 1998. Thereafter, the
MOP may be granted to a non-participating
ASEAN country as soon as that
country extends the same MOP itself. If the non-participating
country does
grant such MOP and maintains such position throughout
stipulated maximum waiver period of eight (8) years, the exclusive application
of the MOP to Malaysia shall then be extended up to 29 December 2002.

The 50% MOP accorded under this Executive Order shall
remain effective regardless of any subsequent changes in the basic Philippine
rate of duty on the afore-mentioned artir;les.
effectivity
afore-mentioned
articles entered or withdrawn
from warehouses
Philippines for consumption shall be subject to qualification under the Rules
of Origin as prescribed in the Agreement on ASEAN Preferential Trading
Arrangements,
as amended, and shall pay the applicable BBC Preferential
Tariff specified under Section 1 hereof.

Any revision/ s to the part numbers
Annex" A" shall be communicated
immediately
to the Philippine
Government
by the ASEAN Secretariat.
The Department
endorse the same to the Bureau of Customs
within five (5) days after receipt
of the offici, I copy of the revised part numbers
fot implementation.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this
'
of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and ninety-six.
By the President:
PMS LI BRARY
Executive Secretary
